user.title: Device Info
user.description: Device Info fills in or corrects a device's manufacturer, model, versions and serial number, for example when the device list shows unknown. After setup, choose Add device on the Device Info entry.

abort.already_configured: Device Info is already set up. Add devices from its entry.

user.title: Choose a device
user.description: Choose the device whose details you want to fill in or correct.

details.title: Details for {device_name}
details.description: Type the details {device_name} should show. Blank fields keep what its integration sets.

data.keep: Keep these even when the device's integration sets its own

data_description.manufacturer: From the device's integration: {original_manufacturer}. Leave blank to keep it.
data_description.model: From the device's integration: {original_model}. Leave blank to keep it.
data_description.model_id: From the device's integration: {original_model_id}. Leave blank to keep it.
data_description.hw_version: From the device's integration: {original_hw_version}. Leave blank to keep it.
data_description.sw_version: From the device's integration: {original_sw_version}. Leave blank to keep it.
data_description.serial_number: From the device's integration: {original_serial_number}. Leave blank to keep it.
data_description.keep: Off: your value fills in what the integration leaves blank, and the integration wins if it sets one later. On: your value always wins and is put back whenever the integration changes it.

reconfigure.title: Details for {device_name}
reconfigure.description: Type the details {device_name} should show. Blank fields keep what its integration sets. To put back everything the integration set, delete this device from Device Info instead.

data.keep: Keep these even when the device's integration sets its own

data_description.model: From the device's integration: {original_model}. Leave blank to keep it.
data_description.model_id: From the device's integration: {original_model_id}. Leave blank to keep it.
data_description.hw_version: From the device's integration: {original_hw_version}. Leave blank to keep it.
data_description.sw_version: From the device's integration: {original_sw_version}. Leave blank to keep it.
data_description.serial_number: From the device's integration: {original_serial_number}. Leave blank to keep it.
data_description.keep: Off: your value fills in what the integration leaves blank, and the integration wins if it sets one later. On: your value always wins and is put back whenever the integration changes it.
